title: fix(service-datasource)!: the datasource admin doors refuse an empty secret instead of sealing it over the working credential
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUSbzmMRfCQ13hL4Jffkmqp)_

Fixes #28928

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches what an empty `secret` does at the datasource admin doors. The fail-closed paragraph in `external-datasources.mdx` (§4 Credentials) stays true: an empty stored credential still fails closed at connect.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at the datasource admin doors (`@objectstack/service-datasource`): an empty `secret` is refused.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`POST /api/v1/datasources` 和 `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/NAME` 收到空字符串 `secret`（`""` 或 `{ "value": "" }`）时，现在回 `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`，消息点名 `secret`，任何写入之前就拒绝：不新建 sys_secret，不改 `credentialsRef`，不删旧行。另外，旧数据里已经存成空值的凭据，连接时的状态原因现在说「凭据为空」，不再误说「sys_secret 行丢失或加密密钥变了」。
- **为什么改**：以前编辑时传空 `secret` 会被当成轮换：新建一个空值的 sys_secret，把引用指过去，再删掉能用的旧行。正在用的连接池照常跑，直到下次连接才坏，而旧凭据已经没了（#28928，QA 记录 #28927）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只多拒绝一种请求体；`null`、不传 `secret`、真实凭据、全空格值的行为都不变。控制台本来就只在字段有值时才发 `secret`，所以不受影响。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts` 的 `assertSecretNotEmpty` 及它在 `createDatasource` / `updateDatasource` 里的两处调用；`datasource-connection-service.ts` 里新拆出的 `secret === ''` 分支。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/datasource-empty-secret-refusal.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 8 passed (8)`（main 上 3 条拒绝用例红，5 条对照两边都绿）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（这是收窄，按规矩先做合同审查）。

## What changes

- **The refusal.** `assertSecretNotEmpty(heading, secret)` (module function in `datasource-admin-service.ts`) throws when the normalized `secret` has `value === ''`. `createDatasource` calls it right after the name check, and `updateDatasource` right after the undeclared-key and inline-`ssl.key` checks, so it runs before any secret is read, written or removed and before the record is stored. The route answers it as it answers those two checks: `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, message `Invalid datasource 'NAME'.` then "The `secret` is empty. Send the credential to store, or leave `secret` out (or null) to keep the stored one. Nothing was written." Only the empty string is judged, so the answer never echoes a credential.
- **Why there and in that shape.** The doors have no `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Their existing refusals for a body (#28549 / #28612 undeclared keys, #28633 inline `ssl.key`) are a plain `Error` thrown first thing in the service and answered `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` by `badRequest`; this reuses that exactly (ruling 3: no new error code). Only these two doors call `createDatasource` / `updateDatasource`.
- **What stays.** `null` and an absent `secret` keep the stored credential (`splitSecret` already maps `null` to absent). A whitespace-only value is not refused: step 1 shows it is sealed and `resolve()` returns it unchanged, so it is a usable value as sent. `POST /api/v1/datasources/test` stores nothing and is untouched.
- **The status reason (ruling 4).** A row sealed empty before this change is still reachable: `resolve()` returns `''` for it. `DatasourceConnectionService.connect` now answers that case on its own: still `failed-credentials`, still no driver built, reason "credential 'REF' is empty (its sys_secret row holds an empty value); set the datasource's secret again". A missing row or a decrypt failure (`undefined`) keeps the old reason.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28928-empty-datasource-secret-refused.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/service-datasource` (non-protocol), both declaration lines, BREAKING banner, the remedy, and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- No new error code, no `packages/spec/**`, no new gate.

**Why `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.** One body that answered 201 / 200 now answers 400; no answer member, code or exported type changes.

## Step 1: measurement on main

Real routes over the real `DatasourceAdminService` on in-memory stores, base `f7c545ad`:

| body `secret` | create | update |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `""` | 201; seals an empty value and binds `credentialsRef` to it | 200; writes a new sys_secret holding `''`, repoints `credentialsRef`, removes the working row |
| `"   "` | 201; seals the 3-space value | 200; rotates to the 3-space value |
| `null` | 201; no `credentialsRef` | 200; no-op on the credential |

`resolve()` returns the sealed string as-is, so `""` yields `''` and `"   "` yields three spaces. **Callers:** none sends an empty `secret` on purpose. The console's `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` (objectui `ui/packages/app-shell`) sets `body.secret` only when the field is truthy, on save and on test; the client SDK has no datasource create/update; hotcrm has no caller.

## Tests

New `packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-empty-secret-refusal.test.ts`, through the real routes over the real service (the harness of `datasource-admin-declared-keys-kept.test.ts`), recording every seam call:

- **PATCH** with `"secret": ""` and with `{ "value": "" }`: 400, `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, message names `secret`; the stored record (its `credentialsRef` included) equals the seed, no secret written, no seam call at all (no put, no removeSecret, no pool).
- **POST** with `"secret": ""`: the same refusal; nothing stored, no secret written, no seam call.
- **Controls:** a real secret still rotates on PATCH (new ref, the working ref removed) and is bound on POST; `secret: null` and an absent `secret` on PATCH change no credential; `secret: null` on POST creates with no ref.

One new case in `datasource-connection-service.test.ts` (D3 block): a resolver returning `''` fails closed with a reason that names the empty credential and contains neither "could not be resolved", "missing sys_secret row" nor "encryption key".

<details><summary>Red on base, green on head, ablation</summary>

- **Base** (the two source files at `f7c545ad`, the tests at head): `Tests 4 failed | 107 passed (111)` across the two files. The three refusal pins received `{ status: 200, success: true }`; the status-reason pin received "credential 'sys_secret:abc' could not be resolved or decrypted (missing sys_secret row, or the encryption key changed)". All five controls green.
- **Head:** `Tests 111 passed (111)`.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the guard line of `assertSecretNotEmpty` replaced by `return;`): `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`, exactly the three refusal pins. Restore: blob after restore equals HEAD's (`1933a09e`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Leftover, same class (seat carries):** `migrateCredential`'s drop-inline refusal (`datasource-admin-service.ts`, the `resolved == null || resolved === ''` check) still says the existing ref "could not be resolved or decrypted (a missing `sys_secret` row, or a changed encryption key)" when the row decrypts to empty. Its outcome (refuse to drop the last inline copy) is right; only the cause text conflates.
- An admin who used to send `"secret": ""` to mean "no change" now gets the 400; the remedy is in the message and the changeset.

## Verification

All readings at head `66a746c6` (one commit on `origin/main` `00d0668d`, after PR #28955 merged). Pins red/green and the ablation were taken before the restart, on base `f7c545ad`; the restart moved no file this diff touches.
